values.meaning: Duration of the active's empowerment window on Kayle's next basic attack
values.quote: empowering her next [[basic attack]] within 6 seconds
values.binNote: The bin's KayleE.BuffDuration is 5, but the wiki text says the empowered attack window is 'within 6 seconds'. Stating the wiki's number (6) here; the bin row disagrees (5).

values.meaning: Queue time for activating Starfire Spellblade's active
values.binNote: The sheet's KayleE data values have no queue-time row; this number only appears in the wiki infobox ('queue time'). Its exact effect on cast/attack timing is not stated by the wiki text.

mechanics.claim: Starfire Spellblade resets Kayle's basic attack timer.
mechanics.quote: Starfire Spellblade {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Kayle's''' basic attack timer.

mechanics.claim: The ability's cooldown starts only after its effect resolves, not when it is activated.
The active grants the empowered attack an uncancellable windup.
mechanics.quote: empowering her next [[basic attack]] within 6 seconds to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}

mechanics.claim: While Aflame (level 11+, Exalted), the active's empowered attack explodes on the target, dealing its damage to surrounding enemies, applying on-hit effects again, and rolling critical strike.
mechanics.quote: The attack explodes upon the target, dealing its damage to surrounding enemies and applying {{tip|on-hit}} effects. This is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers.

mechanics.claim: Even though it shares one cast instance with the triggering attack, the active's on-hit effect is a separate proc instance from the basic attack's own on-hit effect.
mechanics.quote: Despite being one cast instance, ''Starfire Spellblade'' triggers {{iis|Muramana}} {{nie|Shock}} twice on each target, dealing normal bonus damage after the basic attack and increased bonus damage after the spell

mechanics.claim: Starfire Spellblade deals no bonus damage against structures (not applicable to a dummy that counts as an enemy champion).
mechanics.quote: Starfire Spellblade does not deal bonus damage against [[structure|structures]].
